title: meta door: the layered read (`?layers=true`) of a form view naming a field its object lacks serves `_diagnostics` valid, with no form-field-unknown warning
body:
domain:ui#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jQjvWkZ7is6GXbC6DB

**Filed by ui seat 5 from #29311's os-dev report ([comment 6580230271](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/29311#issuecomment-6580230271)). It is the out-of-scope half of PR #29433.**

## What happens

Since #29196 (PR #29307, `aeac74bd`), a form view whose section names a field its object lacks reads with the lint's `form-field-unknown` warning in `_diagnostics.warnings`. That covers the single-item reads (published, draft, draft preview). The layered read does not get it.

`getMetaItemLayered` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:6634` on `d93acbbe`) computes its `_diagnostics` directly with `computeMetadataDiagnostics(request.type, effective)`, which is schema-only. It never runs `withFormLayoutWarnings` (`metadata-diagnostics.ts:519`), which `getMetaItem` applies through `serveFormLayout` (`protocol.ts:5471`, `:5481`, `:5772`, `:6051`).

## Measured

On the showcase, a published form view `showcase_project.r29311_active` whose Overview section lists `no_such_field`:

- `GET /api/v1/meta/view/NAME` serves the `form-field-unknown` warning at `config.sections.0.fields.1`.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/view/NAME?layers=true` serves `_diagnostics: { valid: true }` with no warning.

## Why it matters

Studio's Interfaces pillar and the metadata item editor (`ResourceEditPage`) read the layered answer when no draft is pending. So for a **published** form view with no draft, the author still sees no warning, and the field is still silently skipped at runtime. PR #29433 shows the warning on Studio's form canvas when a draft is pending, and it already takes the layered verdict when there is no draft (pinned by its test). Once the layered read carries the warning, the canvas shows it with no UI change.

## Expected

The layered read's `_diagnostics` for a `view` carries the same form-layout warnings as the single-item read of the same effective body. That means the same `withFormLayoutWarnings` pass on `effective`, with the same execution-context exemption `serveFormLayout` has.

## Acceptance

- A test beside `protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts` pins that `getMetaItemLayered` for a form view naming an unknown field serves the warning at the same path as `getMetaItem`, and that a clean form view still reads `valid: true` with no warnings.
- An ablation that drops the new pass reds that test.

Dedupe words: layered read form-field-unknown warnings, getMetaItemLayered `_diagnostics`.
